author: Pixar
description:
Welcome back to Pixar!! We're sharing a variety of stuff directly from us (the filmmakers at Pixar)! We're going behind the scenes with artists, showing exclusive new short films, and sharing never-before-seen secrets from our movies! 

This week's guests include Peter Sohn (Incredibles 3, Elemental) and Domee Shi (Turning Red, Bao, Elio) sharing some exclusive DELETED SCENES! Plus, the HOPPERS team takes us behind the scenes of one of their favorite moments from the film! Don't forget to check out Disney/Pixar's HOPPERS, now in theaters -- and check out more episodes of THE PIXAR SHOW!!
